title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 38
paragraphs: All these things coming together, fear fell upon the barbarians; and the Delphians, perceiving that they were fleeing, came down after them and killed a great many. Those who survived fled straight to Boeotia. These returning barbarians reported, so I am told, that in addition to what has been described, they saw still other miraculous things: two men, they said, in full armor and of more than human stature, followed them, slaying and pursuing.
